content_sections.text: Contract allowed for one year; may be extended on annual work evaluation as needed Contract may be ended with one month's notice if work is found unsatisfactory No permanent employment; any claim for regularisation is invalid Casual leave as per state employees for the calendar year; no other leave Post is not transferable; code of conduct of state employees applies Deputy Commissioner of the district is the appointing authority

content_sections.text: Preliminary merit list on percentage of marks in Matric (20), Inter (20), Graduation (30) and Postgraduation (30) Computer Hindi and English typing test for five times the vacancies from the top of the merit list Final merit list based on passing the typing test with accuracy No interview in selection Merit weightage: Matric 20, Inter 20, Graduation 30, Postgraduation 30 (total 100) Typing carries no marks; final merit list on passing typing with accuracy Certificates verified within three months of appointment; police verification of selected candidates Names of selected candidates displayed on the notice board

content_sections.text: Matric marksheet and certificate Inter marksheet and certificate Graduation marksheet and certificate Postgraduation marksheet and certificate Residential certificate and caste certificate Additional desired educational qualification / diploma certificate; two self-attested passport size photographs

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DCPU Ranchi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DCPU Ranchi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Counsellor.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DCPU Ranchi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed application form attached to the notice (pages 4-5)) and send it to Office, District Child Protection Unit, Collectorate Building, Block-"B", Room No.-111, PIN Code-834001 Ranchi (Jharkhand), by registered post / speed post, to reach by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 35 years (as on 1 August 2026). Relaxation: Extremely Backward Class / Backward Class Maximum 37 years, Female (Unreserved) Maximum 38 years, SC / ST (Male and Female) Maximum 40 years, Divyang candidates Maximum 40 (Unreserved), 42 (EBC/BC), 43 (Female Unreserved), 45 (SC/ST).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Remuneration Rs. 23170.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Postgraduate (Social Science / Psychology); additional qualification: proficiency in computer (Hindi and English).

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Reservation rules will be followed in selection.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Incomplete or unclear applications will not be considered. Applications received after the last date will not be considered. Applications sent by any mode other than registered post or speed post will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Preliminary merit list on percentage of marks in Matric (20), Inter (20), Graduation (30) and Postgraduation (30). Computer Hindi and English typing test for five times the vacancies from the top of the merit list. Final merit list based on passing the typing test with accuracy. No interview in selection.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract allowed for one year; may be extended on annual work evaluation as needed. Contract may be ended with one month's notice if work is found unsatisfactory. No permanent employment; any claim for regularisation is invalid.
